columns.name: TEMPLATE_DEFN_ID
columns.description: Primary key of Template Definition.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Identifies template type of the performance document.

columns.name: USE_CALC_RATINGS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if section rating needs to be set based on calculated value.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS

columns.name: SET_ID
columns.description: Identifies a set of reference data shared across business units and other entities. Also known as Reference Data Sets, they are used to filter reference data in transactional UIs.

columns.name: DOC_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key of Document Type.

columns.name: PROCESS_FLOW_ID
columns.description: Indicates the Process Flow definiton that is used in this template definiton.

columns.name: DATE_FROM
columns.description: This is the date when the performance template is valid from.

columns.name: DATE_TO
columns.description: This is the last day that the performance template is valid.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of the Performance Template.

columns.name: CALCULATE_RATINGS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the system should calculate the ratings for a section or a document.

columns.name: ROUNDING_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the rounding rule that will be used for ratings that are calculated by the system. Valid values are Standard, Up and Down.

columns.name: DECIMAL_PLACES
columns.description: Indicates the number of decimal places for calculated ratings.

columns.name: MAPPING_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: This applies to the Overall Rating section, where the system must choose an overall rating from the rating model, based on a calculated rating.

columns.name: SHOW_PARTICIPANT_NAMES
columns.description: Indicates whether to display participant names to worker.

columns.name: SELECT_MGR_ALLOWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether worker can select manager when generating document.

columns.name: STAR_RATING_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether to use star rating model or not.

columns.name: SET_ROLE_MINIMUMS_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether to set the minimum number for each role and also the total number for the evaluation.

columns.name: SET_ROLE_MAXIMUMS_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether to set the maximum number for each role and also the total number for the evaluation.

columns.name: TOTAL_MIN_PARTICIPANTS
columns.description: Stores the total minimum number of participants required in the document

columns.name: TOTAL_MAX_PARTICIPANTS
columns.description: Stores the total maximum number of participants required in the document

columns.name: ENFORCE_MIN_PCPNS_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether to enforce minimum number of participants allowed in the document.

columns.name: USE_WRK_CONNECTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether to show  the search by workers' network connections in the social product when adding participants

columns.name: WRK_SEE_MGR_PCPN_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether worker can see the participants added by manager

columns.name: PCPN_FEEDBACK_REQ_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether the participant feedback is required

columns.name: PCPN_DECLINE_OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Stores whether to give the participant the option whether to Accept/Decline the feedback request

columns.name: AUTO_POPULATE_MM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate matrix managers are automatically populated as participants when performance document is created.

columns.name: SEND_REQUEST_TO_MM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates request will be sent to matrix manager particpants when performance document is created, which automatically gives them access to the document.

columns.name: DEFAULT_MATRIX_PCPN_ROLE_ID
columns.description: Indicates default matrix role to use when automatically populating matrix managers as participants.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: DIGITAL_SIGNATURE_FLAG
columns.description: Display digital signature flag.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: KUDOS_REGION_FLAG
columns.description: Display kudos region flag.

columns.name: SHOW_WKR_CALC_RATING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Calculated Ratings should be visible to Worker.

columns.name: SHOW_MGR_CALC_RATING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Calculated Ratings should be visible to Manager.

columns.name: SHOW_MM_CALC_RATING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether calculated ratings should be visible to matrix managers.

columns.name: SHOW_PCPN_CALC_RATING_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether calculated ratings should be visible to participants.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Stores request id of the last ESS job submitted for this performance template

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: Stores request status of the last ESS job submitted for this performance template

columns.name: SHOW_CHECK_IN_REGION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the CheckIn region should display in performance document.

columns.name: SHOW_FEEDBACK_REQ_REGION_FLAG
columns.description: indicates if the feedback request region should display in the performance document.

columns.name: ENABLE_SYNC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the performance template is configured to use synchronized goals

columns.name: ALLOW_WKR_SELECT_MM_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Allow worker to select matrix manager role.

columns.name: ALLOW_MGR_SELECT_MM_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Allow manager to select matrix manager role.

columns.name: ALL_MM_MGR_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Specify all manager types for auto population as participants.

columns.name: MM_MANAGER_TYPES
columns.description: Specify manager types for auto population as participants.

columns.description: Minimum Length of comments
